title: Job Tracker
teaser: A scoring tool to cut through job search noise.

sections.problem: I had a growing list of roles and no consistent way to compare them beyond gut feel. Spreadsheets tracked status fine but said nothing about whether a role was actually worth pursuing relative to the others on the list.
sections.build: A scoring tool that weighs fit factors like comp floor, Glassdoor rating, and domain match, then ranks roles so I could tell at a glance which ones deserved more time and which ones were just noise.
sections.technical: Node.js Express local app, server-side JSON persistence with graceful degradation fallback so the tool still works if the data file is missing or malformed.
sections.learning: The first scoring model over-weighted comp and under-weighted team structure, which didn't match how I actually felt about roles once I sat with the scores. Watching the gap between the model's ranking and my gut reaction was the most useful part of building it.
sections.next: Thinking about adding a feedback loop that reweights criteria based on which roles I actually pursued vs skipped.
